description: Source code for LWM2M security object implementation in Zephyr OS, including resource definitions, instance management, and initialization functions.

methods.name: security_create
methods.description: Creates a new security object instance with default values and resource initialization.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_inst_id_to_index
methods.description: Converts an object instance ID to an internal index.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_index_to_inst_id
methods.description: Converts an internal index to an object instance ID.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_short_id_to_inst
methods.description: Finds an instance ID based on a short server ID.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the security mode for a given context.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_init
methods.description: Initializes the security object and creates the first instance.
